record.title: Côte d’Ivoire inherited prohibition on land exports of coffee, cocoa and cashew
record.scope: National terrestrial export routes for the three specified agricultural products; enforcement examples toward Ghana, Guinea and Burkina Faso
record.crossings: No exhaustive gate list; reported interceptions on Ghana/Guinea approaches and at inland Doropo
record.movement: Coffee, cocoa and cashew exports by land; no general traveller or unrelated-goods closure.
record.exceptions: The notice permits export through designated Abidjan and San-Pedro maritime offices; land exceptions not established.
record.imposing_authority: Côte d’Ivoire Directorate General of Customs
record.enforcement: Customs reports interdictions of attempted Ghana/Guinea land exports in February and May 2017 and Burkina Faso-bound coffee in April 2026; these are attributed official claims, not independent field observations.
record.consequences: Officially reported cargo/vehicle seizures; no universal implementation claim.
record.relationship: No duplicate located among 638 current rows; national rule encompasses the Ghana cocoa pointer and directly documented related products/routes.
record.status_observation: Ban restated in an official April 23 2026 enforcement account; no endpoint established and no automatic extension to cutoff.
record.official_rationale: Economic protection and prevention of Ghana-directed cocoa outflow are explicitly stated for the October 2017 reinforcement; the original 2005 rule’s motive is not separately established.
record.context: 2013 reminder refers to a 2005 circular; October 2017 measures reinforced an existing restriction.
record.uncertainty: Original commencement not established: October 16 2013 is a reminder, not proven onset. All-year continuity, exceptions and cessation unknown. Inland seizure locations are not represented as border-post closures.

historical.duration_note: No interval: unknown onset and/or endpoint; continuity not reconstructed.
